card.text: Explore Sappho in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Sappho is a main-belt asteroid. Explore its calibrated nonconvex reconstruction from DAMIT, version 2017-06-09. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT model 1832
shape.summary: Shape made from changes in brightness as the asteroid rotates. Gray grid: no surface imagery.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
